families.page_title: Tick-borne encephalitis: epidemiology, diagnosis and prevention
evidence_points: The guidance describes tick-borne encephalitis epidemiology, diagnosis and prevention.
It includes information on UK-acquired cases and areas of detected virus activity.
Diagnostic support is available through the Rare and Imported Pathogens Laboratory.
There is no specific antiviral treatment; prevention includes tick avoidance and vaccination for defined travel risks.

families.topic: West Nile virus epidemiology, transmission, diagnosis and prevention
evidence_points: The guidance describes West Nile virus as a mosquito-borne flavivirus.
Birds are the principal reservoir and mosquitoes transmit infection between birds and to humans.
Most human infections are asymptomatic, while a small proportion can develop neurological disease.
The guidance supports travel, exposure, diagnostic and public-health assessment.
